source: CDC PLACES: Local Data for Better Health, 2024 release
citation: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. PLACES: Local Data for Better Health. Accessed September 28, 2026. https://www.cdc.gov/places
note: These are model estimates for adults from CDC PLACES, 2024 release. The model uses a 2022 CDC telephone health survey. The values are not direct counts. The CDC advises against using PLACES to rank the overall health of counties. The values are adjusted for age, so counties with older or younger people compare fairly. County details show the share before the age adjustment and the likely range (95%). The CDC does not endorse this atlas.

datasets.title: Current asthma among adults
datasets.note: A health professional told these adults that they have asthma. These adults say they still have it. People report this themselves. Most differences between counties are smaller than the 95% likely range. Treat small gaps on this map as noise.
